tooling.emulation: Playwright Pixel 7 Android user agent plus Chromium mobile metrics, touch, and viewport; not physical handset

network.latencyUnits: configured CDP latency in milliseconds; effective timing may differ by request/connection

throttling.coldCache: Network.setCacheDisabled=true with a fresh context per route/repeat
throttling.warmCache: cache enabled; one persistent context per route; one untimed priming navigation before timed repeats; cache hits asserted from Chromium CDP

tooling.egressGuard: Dedicated loopback HTTP proxy forwards only the exact A20 127.0.0.1 origin; Chromium DNS rules reject other hostnames; no request interception is installed, preserving browser cache

methodology.loadCompletion: visible route-specific rendered content plus network idle when reached, followed by 2.5s LCP quiet period; capture occurs before UI interaction
methodology.cls: maximum CLS session window; excludes layout-shift entries with hadRecentInput; window resets after >1s gap and is capped at 5s
methodology.interactionLatency: scripted local click to navigation/DOM completion on final repeat only; descriptive lab latency and not field INP
methodology.summary: p50 and maximum across five samples; no field p75 or INP claim

network-cold.criteria: exploratory local lab comparison with web.dev good thresholds; five samples are too few for field CWV or p75 claims
